daily.title: Mere Route Deviation Cannot Justify GST Detention or Penalty U/s 129: GSTAT Ernakulam
daily.summary: GSTAT Ernakulam quashes detention, GST demand and penalty for route deviation during multiple deliveries supported by valid invoices and updated e-way bills. The Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal, Ernakulam Bench , held that GST law prescribes no fixed route or delivery sequence when a vehicle carries consignments for several recipients. Where goods are covered by genuine tax invoices and valid, updated e-way bills and are proceeding to the declared destinations, a change of route by itself cannot justify detention or penalty under Section 129 .
